player_prompt.intro:
Oli Muzannyi {player_id} mu Chopsticks. Ku luzannya, linga kimu ku:
  + Alinyisa:  '[attack M O]'  ambayo M=lukoko lwo (0 oba 1), O=lukoko lwa mukwano (0 oba 1).
    - Lukoko lwa mukwano lunakuwa na kivule kya lukoko lwo; bwe lina wakati wa 5, lunakuwa 0.
  + Zikya:   '[split L R]'  okuzikya vvu ku lukoko lwange oluvunze (L+R = vvu vyange).
Yingiza kimu ku kifo kyo.

invalid_move.split_no_change: Split ateekwa okukyusa enkula y'omukono gwo.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Kuzannyira kibafu. Wekka “[attack M O]” oba “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} alinyisa P{opp_id}’s hand {opp_idx}: iliva ku {opp_val} okutuuka {new_val}.
